register_map.notes: Register map is accessed via I2C with 8-bit register addresses. Auto-increment supported for sequential reads/writes.

read_channels.notes: Distance measurement in millimeters. Raw value is computed by device firmware; no conversion formula needed.

access_model.notes: I2C register access: write register address, then read/write data. Auto-increment supported.

steps.notes: Apply AVDD supply (2.6V to 3.5V).
Wait for tBOOT (1.2 ms max) after XSHUT high.
Set XSHUT high to exit hardware standby.

operation_flows.notes: Power-up sequence with XSHUT controlled by host.

steps.notes: Apply AVDD supply; XSHUT is pulled high automatically.
Wait for tBOOT (1.2 ms max) for firmware boot.

operation_flows.notes: Power-up sequence with XSHUT tied to AVDD.

preconditions: Device powered up and out of reset.

steps.notes: Perform initialization and load calibration data (SPAD, temperature, offset, crosstalk). Details in API user manual UM2039. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.

operation_flows.notes: Initialization and load calibration data phase before first ranging or after reset.

steps.notes: Call API function to start single ranging; system returns to SW standby automatically. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.
Poll API function to check if measurement is complete.

transaction.notes: Read distance result from device registers (address not specified in datasheet).

steps.notes: Read distance value from device.

outputs.notes: Distance value computed by device firmware.

operation_flows.notes: Single ranging mode: perform one range measurement then return to SW standby. Register-level trigger and result register address not specified in datasheet; API handles details.

steps.notes: Call API function to start continuous ranging; measurements repeat until stop. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.
Poll API function to check if measurement is complete.

transaction.notes: Read distance result from device registers (address not specified in datasheet).

steps.notes: Read distance value from device.

User must stop ranging to return to SW standby; last measurement completes before stopping. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.

outputs.notes: Distance value computed by device firmware.

operation_flows.notes: Continuous ranging mode: measurements repeat until stopped. Register-level trigger and result register address not specified in datasheet; API handles details.

steps.notes: Call API function to start timed ranging; inter-measurement period defined by user. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.
Poll API function to check if measurement is complete.

transaction.notes: Read distance result from device registers (address not specified in datasheet).

steps.notes: Read distance value from device.

User must stop ranging to return to SW standby; if stop during measurement, measurement completes before stopping. Canonicalized from a bus op because the step has no bus transaction and is described as API/abstract behavior.

outputs.notes: Distance value computed by device firmware.

operation_flows.notes: Timed ranging mode: continuous ranging with user-defined inter-measurement delay. Register-level trigger and result register address not specified in datasheet; API handles details.

preconditions: Ranging has been started via API.

steps.notes: Poll API function to check if measurement is complete.

transaction.notes: Read distance result from device registers (address not specified in datasheet).

steps.notes: Read distance value from device.

outputs.notes: Distance value computed by device firmware.

operation_flows.notes: Polling mode: check status of ongoing measurement by polling an API function. Result register address not specified in datasheet; API handles details.

preconditions: Ranging has been started via API.

steps.notes: Wait for interrupt on GPIO1 indicating new measurement available.

transaction.notes: Read distance result from device registers (address not specified in datasheet).

steps.notes: Read distance value from device.

outputs.notes: Distance value computed by device firmware.

operation_flows.notes: Interrupt mode: GPIO1 pin signals when new measurement is available. Result register address not specified in datasheet; API handles details.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up sequence: apply AVDD, then set XSHUT high (or wait for boot if XSHUT tied high). Wait tBOOT (1.2 ms max).
Perform initialization and load calibration data (SPAD, temperature, offset, crosstalk). Details in API user manual UM2039.

read_sequence.notes: Ranging is initiated via API. The device firmware handles register access internally. No direct register read sequence is specified for obtaining distance data.

timing_constraints.name: tBOOT
timing_constraints.notes: Maximum boot time after XSHUT high.

timing_constraints.name: timing_budget
timing_constraints.notes: Default timing budget for a range measurement.

timing_constraints.name: t_BUF
timing_constraints.notes: Bus free time between transmissions minimum.

error_conditions.detection: I2C bus NACK after address or data byte
Polling or interrupt timeout exceeds expected measurement duration
Device firmware returns error code for invalid ranging

power_states.name: HW STANDBY
power_states.description: AVDD present, XSHUT low. No I2C communication. Current ~5 uA typical.

power_states.name: SW STANDBY
power_states.description: After firmware boot, device ready for commands. Current ~6 uA typical.

power_states.name: RANGING
power_states.description: Active ranging measurement. Current ~19 mA typical.

evidence_spans.snippet: The first byte contains the device address (0x52) and also specifies the data direction.
The minimum range measurement period is 8 ms.
Single ranging Ranging is performed only once after the API function is called.
Continuous ranging. Ranging is performed in a continuous way after the API function is called.
Timed ranging. Ranging is performed in a continuous way after the API function is called.
The user can get the final data using a polling or an interrupt mechanism.
An interrupt pin (GPIO1) sends an interrupt to the host when a new measurement is available.

requires_human: Calibration data (SPAD, temperature, offset, crosstalk) must be loaded during init; details are in API user manual UM2039.
Ranging profiles (default, high accuracy, long range, high speed) are configured via API; register-level details not provided.
Interrupt and polling modes are described at API level; low-level register access for status checking not specified.
Temperature calibration must be repeated when temperature varies more than 8°C; exact procedure in API manual.
Register-level trigger for single ranging not specified in datasheet; API function call is used.
Register address for distance result not specified in datasheet; API handles it.
Register-level trigger for continuous ranging not specified in datasheet; API function call is used.
Register-level trigger for timed ranging not specified in datasheet; API function call is used.
